_doc: Tuning for the Drift campaign (scripts/space/drift.gd makes the map, campaign.gd runs it, docs/CONTENT.md section 8). map: the defaults of every region's map (docs/CONTENT.md section 15; a region file may override any of these keys): nodes = how many in all (fixed places included; [least, most] rolls it), size = the region in px, margin = how close to the edge a random node may sit, min_spacing = least distance between two nodes, lane_third and lane_fourth = chance a node asks for a 3rd and a 4th lane (all ask for 2), lane_length = longest lane made for fun (connecting lanes may be longer), clearance = how near a lane may pass another node, clan_trader = chance a trader node is a Scrapper one (Ma's collectors take payments there). node_weights: the type of every non-fixed node is rolled by these (a region's own node_weights replace them). types: label, colour and glyph the map draws (`exit` is a region's exit beacon). The fixed places are in the region files (data/regions/*.json, places: pos in px; jitter = seeded wobble; faction = who runs it; hidden_until = a flag that must be set before the node shows; beacon = always on the map; start = where the region begins). run (scripts/space/regions.gd): a run crosses `stages` regions; stage 1 is `start`; the exit beacon of every stage offers `offers` [least, most] regions valid for the next stage (rolled by their weight times the `rarity` factor, never one already visited), the last stage's exit leads to the `ending` region (which has no exit); Ma Gantry's debt clock runs for the first `debt_stages` stages and is paused after; `entry` is the arrival node added to a region with no start place, `exit` its exit beacon (far side). fuel: the item `fuel` costs `price` credits at stations (traders asking `trader_multiplier` times that), a drift jump costs `drift_hull` hull integrity. A normal jump takes 1 fuel times the thrust-weighted mean `fuel_mult` of the powered engines (campaign.gd jump_cost; the fraction is kept and paid in whole fuel). debt: Ma Gantry's loan (total owed, payment due every `every` jumps; `kettle` is the unique she gives when it is paid off). danger: jumps at which the enemy tier goes up. enemies: the enemy of a fight by kind and tier: a design file (a path), or a generated ship (scripts/space/shipgen.gd, data/enemy_tables.json): gen: takes the faction the region of the node meets in such a fight, gen:<faction> names one, and :ram after it makes it a ram-bowed rammer. The fixed designs (pirate_raider, rustfang_rammer) stay available by id. loot: after a won fight, the credits range (times the tier; x1.5 for a captured ship); the salvage pick of the surviving parts is scripts/space/salvage.gd (threat_picks: the extra parts it offers after an enemy of 4 or 5 skulls of threat, by skulls), and its strip row (a won fight) or the scrap paid for a captured ship is (strip_base + strip_per_part x the enemy's parts left) x the tier. prices: hull repair per point, the fraction of value paid when selling, the recruit price, how many recruits a station offers. values: what things are worth (sale = half): per material rarity, per component tier, unique parts, and per item kind. stations: the menu of each place (services: fuel, sell, stock, debt, repair, recruit; stock = id -> price; recruit = species -> weight; faction decides refusal and discounts). Engine prices (engine wave 1, nothing of tier 4 or 5 is ever sold): the Mk1 price of the part's line (Kickjet 90, Concord Thruster 120, Ion Drive 300) times the part value of its tier over that of tier 1 (values.tier: 40, 90, 160), rounded to 10; Strafe Jets cost half of the Concord Thruster of their tier (half the recipe), a Long-Burn Drive the same as one. `clan_trader` is the menu of a Scrapper trader node. instant_jump: true keeps the beta's jump (clicking a node jumps at once); false makes a jump a spool (jump.spool seconds of charge, campaign.gd start_jump and tick_jump) that waits while a hostile is within jump.hostile_range px, with the sector flow of docs/CONTENT.md section 11.
